messages:
deploybot: Scheduled deploy to Dedicated for tenant BlueHarbor at 2026-04-02T20:00Z. Artifact: inference-server@v2.14.1 pinned. Release notes link: https://releases.redwood.example/blueharbor/v2.14.1 :truck:
marie (eng-release): Thanks. Noting KMS rotation for BlueHarbor is planned 2026-04-02T21:00Z — need to avoid overlap. Can we move deploy to 20:30Z or hold until rotation completes?
josh (sre): If rotation starts at 21:00Z we should avoid a rolling restart during that window. 20:30Z gives us a 30m buffer for canary + health checks. Also propose stricter rollback thresholds for this tenant: 5% 5xx or p99 > 1200ms for 10m => auto-rollback.
anya (pm): BlueHarbor requested a short quiet window 20:00-22:00Z. They prefer earlier but are ok with 20:30Z if we confirm KMS is separate. Lina — can you confirm customer tolerance?
lina (cs): Confirmed with BlueHarbor: they prefer 20:30Z start, and they will not run heavy inference jobs until 22:00Z. They also asked for a short release note summary to share internally.
marie (eng-release): Pushing detailed release notes here: 
- Pinned runtime: inference-server@v2.14.1 (patch: LLM batching fix, reduced memory leak on xg-qual buckets)
- Config changes: default batch_max_tokens=1024 -> 2048 for tenant slice B
- Danger flags: kv-cache migration required (transparent)

Canary plan:
1) canary slice (5%) deploy to dedicated nodes (20:30Z)
2) 10m observation, run smoke suite (see /ops/smoke/blueharbor.yaml)
3) if ok, ramp to 30% over 10m, then 100% after 15m

Deploy command (ops):
```
redwood deploy --tenant blueharbor --artifact inference-server:v2.14.1 --slices canary=5,ramp=30,stable=100 --kms-lock false
```

Note: set --kms-lock false to avoid blocking KMS rotation if BlueHarbor rotates later; but we must ensure keys are accessible.
ops-bot: Reminder: patch window overlap detected with KMS rotation. Flagging for manual ack.
josh (sre): Manual ack from SRE required before unblocking. I'll run a preflight checklist:
- verify KV cache migration script exit codes
- canary smoke tests ready (curl + token reuse)
- healthcheck /metrics target for 5xx and p99 in promrule:alerts/blueharbor-deploy.json
I'll post the checklist output here at 20:15Z.
marie (eng-release): I updated the rollout config to include the rollback thresholds Josh suggested and attached the changes to the release note page. Also added an emergency rollback command: `redwood rollout rollback --tenant blueharbor --to-tag v2.14.0`
anya (pm): Approving 20:30Z start if SRE ack by 20:20Z and CS confirms BlueHarbor ready.
lina (cs): BlueHarbor acked readiness at 19:58Z. They will monitor dashboards and hold any scheduled batch jobs.
josh (sre): SRE preflight done: kv-migrate script returned exit 0 on staging, smoke suite green, alerting verified. Manual ack: SRE approves rollout. :white_check_mark:
marie (eng-release): Great — marking deploybot to start at 20:30Z. Release notes short summary for customer (one-paragraph): "v2.14.1 improves batching efficiency and fixes a memory issue observed on long-lived sessions. The endpoint remains backwards compatible; we pinned this runtime to avoid downstream variance. Please report any latency regressions to cs@redwood.example."
lina (cs): Sent short summary to BlueHarbor at 20:05Z. They replied :thumbsup:.
deploybot: Starting canary deploy to BlueHarbor (5%) at 20:30Z...
marie (eng-release): Observing canary - check logs and metric spikes.
josh (sre): Canary metrics: p99 480ms (baseline 450ms), 5xx 0.02% - below threshold. Continuing ramp to 30%.
marie (eng-release): Ramp complete to 30% at 20:45Z, holding 15m before full rollout.
ops-bot: Note: KMS rotation scheduled 21:00Z. Current deploy is configured with --kms-lock false; ensure keys accessible after rotation.
josh (sre): Monitoring, no auth errors so far. If any KMS errors appear, priority rollback.
marie (eng-release): All good. Proceeding to 100% at 21:00Z- but hold! KMS rotation just started per ops-bot. Pausing ramp to avoid overlap. Rolling back to 30% until rotation completes.
lina (cs): BlueHarbor notified of temporary pause. They are fine with rollback to 30% during rotation.
josh (sre): Kept at 30%, no errors. KMS rotation finished 21:12Z, no key misses. Proceeding to resume ramp to 100% now.
marie (eng-release): Ramp resumed and completed 21:25Z. Closing the thread and updating release notes with final rollout times and metrics. :tada:
